headline: Continued but smaller SE swell with offshore winds. Another day to target a surf.
body:
Dawn to Midday: We will still have rideable SE swell on deck and winds look offshore for clean conditions again. This is another day to target some fun waves, currently expecting surf in the waist high range early.
Afternoon Outlook: Surf eases further but remains plenty worthwhile, in the waist high range or so.

headline: Continued but smaller SE swell with offshore winds. Another day to target a surf.
body:
Dawn to Midday: We will still have rideable SE swell on deck and winds look offshore for clean conditions again. This is another day to target some fun waves, currently expecting surf in the waist-stomach+ high range early.
Afternoon Outlook: Surf eases further but remains plenty worthwhile, in the waist high range or so.

headline: Continued fun but easing S/SE swell with offshore winds. Another day to target some surf.
body:
Dawn to Midday: The size eases some into the stomach-chest high range, but we still have fun S/SE swell on deck and winds look offshore NW for clean conditions again. This is another day to target some fun approachable waves so plan to get wet, especially if Monday was a little too much for you.
Afternoon Outlook: Smaller, but still fun surf with continued offshore NW winds and widespread clean conditions.

headline: Continued SE swell with fun sized surf, but textured with sideshore NW/NNW trending N winds.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Rideable SE swell on deck and winds currently look sideshore NW/NNW for side textured conditions. Still some fun sized surf up to waist-stomach high, but you may want to consider making a drive North or South for more favorable conditions.
Afternoon Outlook: Winds trend even more unfavorable N into the afternoon for deteriorating conditions.
